mentions.name: Shuto
mentions.description: This app helps users find good driving routes, with an algorithm in development that defaults to sensible routes like taking the M25 instead of cutting through London, countering Waze's routing choices. The creator is seeking testers.
mentions.problem: Difficulty finding good driving routes; Waze suggests cutting through London for the author's contract gigs rather than taking the M25 sensibly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got so sick of not being able to find good driving routes that I'm working on https://shuto.app but also because Waze wants but to cut through London for my current contract gigs rather than take the M25 sensibly I'm also working on having the algo handle that for default.
